daily_aggregation: independent Poisson counts with exact daily intensity integrals
intraday_homogeneous_pairing: identical daily counts and scores by design; do not pool these controls

rate_profiles.seasonal: weekly amplitude 0.45, annual amplitude 0.60, random phases
rate_profiles.trend: geometric growth from 0.5 to 2.0, normalized to requested time-average rate
rate_profiles.step: 4-fold change at a random point between 35% and 65% of the horizon
